capture.final_message:
Treat the two conjuncts independently:

- The first is the generic extensionality principle for bundled set-like objects: an affine subspace is determined by its underlying point set. Thus `SetLike.coe` is injective by `SetLike.coe_injective` (equivalently, affine-subspace extensionality).

- For the second, use the defining representation of `vectorSpan k s` as the `k`-submodule generated by all differences `p -ᵥ q` with `p, q ∈ s`. Reduce the set inclusion to the pointwise goal
  \[
  p,q\in s \implies p-ᵥ q\in \operatorname{vectorSpan}_k(s).
  \]
  Each such difference is one of the generators, so it belongs to the spanning submodule via the canonical generator-to-span inclusion.

Finally combine these two independent facts with `And.intro`.
